New player model, decided by Jack Heart 2026-11-14 ("Yeah I think this is closer to what I mean. Let's try this"). Written at the end of scratch/exp-73-group-an-experiment.md under "Players compose"; build it in this PR. Summary: a player is a checkpoint seat, or any author Pydantic record whose fields contain players (e.g. Manabot's PUCT(over=small, belief=Final(experiment="tla-belief", job="sampler"), simulations=64), which can wrap again). Etude walks the fields for checkpoint leaves and knows nothing about search. Player identity is the tree with leaves replaced by resolved checkpoint keys. Load once per checkpoint per machine: load(checkpoint), batched across every player and game using it. An author hook builds each seat's agent from the tree with loaded leaves, in the game process. play(match, agents) runs the game. With no wrapper, the agent is the loaded network. Delete the Inference record (source/config) as the way a checkpoint plays; a seat's inference= goes. Keep stored results readable: an old Inference(config=X) player reads as its checkpoint wrapped by X's config, under its old key. Coordinate with EXP-75 (#115), which owns seats and PolicyKey: use its seats as the leaves, and sync onto main if #115 lands first.
